title: mikania houstoniana var. guatemalensis
intro: Mikania houstoniana var. guatemalensis, commonly known as Mexican pennywort, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family and is native to Central and South America. Mexican pennywort is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antidiabetic properties, making it a promising treatment for various diseases. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial activity, and show neuroprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of Mexican pennywort include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource for traditional medicine.
